conclusion: When support-angle overhang filtering drops a qualifying sharp tip that is exposed in the direct adjacent-layer difference, preserve that direct difference as a separate tip-contact source. Associate only tips that are both absent from the ordinary overhang adjacency and actually inside the direct difference, intersecting the local radius derived from the existing tip and interface-flow settings. Do not add this source to ordinary support regions, and keep the existing collision, clearance, blocker, bridge and critical-region rules.

Final rear gaps are 0.572044 and 0.792387 mm at Z 0.60 and Z 0.90; front gaps remain 0.568936 and 0.557715 mm. Source bearing gaps at contact Z 0.45, 0.75 and 1.05 are zero, and first-layer interface/brim overlap is 0 mm2. All 800 final extrusion paths match the verified diagnostic build exactly. Support generation took 2.726 seconds and Print::process took 3.224 seconds without the large stage trace, versus 5.911 and 6.329 seconds in the original diagnostic run. Existing left-hand support/interface/brim paths have no removed or changed entries. Only QQ is verified; this is not a claim of universal model coverage or universal speedup.
